Position Overview The Staff Accountant role focuses on supporting routine accounting records, reconciliations and reporting preparation. This full-time, United States-based remote role calls for clear communication and dependable execution. Daily assignments may be straightforward, but their quality depends on reading information accurately, organizing the next steps and documenting what has been completed. Remote collaboration and quality Because colleagues may rely on shared systems rather than in-person conversations, organized notes are important. Explain what has been completed, what remains unresolved and which next action is needed. Treat sensitive records with appropriate discretion and follow established procedures when an issue requires another person's judgment. The role particularly values fundamental accounting accuracy, clear files and responsible follow-up. Relevant Capabilities Basic accounting terminology Spreadsheet accuracy and document organization Ability to handle confidential information What Dependable Performance Looks Like The goal is straightforward: complete assigned work with care, make outcomes understandable and leave the next person with reliable information. Thoughtful communication also makes handoffs easier to understand and helps prevent unnecessary repetition. Careful habits, professional communication and consistent follow-up create value beyond any single completed task.

review_candidates.title: Senior Operations Project Manager
review_candidates.description: Senior Operations & Program Manager ARGOS DESTINATIONS | Full-Time | Remote, Peru-Based Reports to: CEO & CFO About Argos Destinations Argos Destinations is a travel atelier creating highly curated journeys at the intersection of culture, experiential learning, and holistic wellness. We work with international partners, suppliers, and discerning private clients. Our standards demand precision, discretion, accountability, and thoughtful service. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced, highly autonomous Senior Operations & Program Manager to lead execution across a growing portfolio of international programs and private journeys. Working directly with the CEO and CFO, this individual will translate strategic direction into structured operational plans, lead a distributed team, anticipate challenges, and ensure commitments are fulfilled without constant executive intervention. This is a senior operational leadership position, not an administrative or task-coordination role. The successful candidate will demonstrate exceptional judgment, attention to detail, independent problem-solving, and the ability to synthesize complex operational information into concise, decision-ready executive reporting. Success in this position is measured by dependable outcomes, operational accuracy, and accountability—not simply completed task lists. Key Responsibilities End-to-End Program & Project Ownership Independently manage multiple concurrent projects from initial planning and scoping through execution, delivery, financial reconciliation, and closeout. Establish project milestones, timelines, budgets, dependencies, responsibilities, and measurable completion criteria. Maintain accountability for project outcomes, ensuring every commitment is fulfilled and verified. Team Leadership & Operational Accountability Lead and supervise remote reservations, administrative, and project contributors. Establish priorities, delegate effectively, monitor execution, and verify the accuracy and completeness of deliverables. Identify performance gaps, provide clear direction, and ensure timely resolution. Maintain continuity across international teams, suppliers, and time zones. Project Management & Operational Systems Build and maintain comprehensive project-management systems using Asana or equivalent platforms. Monitor deadlines, critical paths, supplier commitments, financial obligations, approval requirements, and outstanding deliverables. Develop and implement standard operating procedures, quality-control mechanisms, and reporting systems. Improve operational efficiency, consistency, and accountability. Financial & Operational Oversight Oversee budgets, supplier quotations, payment schedules, reservations, contracts, and financial reconciliation. Verify the accuracy of supplier confirmations, accommodation categories, service inclusions, and client-facing commitments. Identify financial discrepancies, operational inconsistencies, and potential risks before they escalate. Ensure all operational and financial records are accurate, current, and supported by appropriate documentation. Executive Reporting & Decision Support Consolidate substantial volumes of operational information into clear, concise executive summaries. Distinguish between confirmed facts, outstanding matters, risks, and decisions requiring executive approval. Present issues with recommended solutions, priorities, and actionable next steps. Exercise sound independent judgment while recognizing appropriate boundaries for executive escalation. Reduce the need for executive intervention through proactive management and reliable follow-through. Essential Qualifications Minimum 5–7 years of progressively responsible experience in operations, program management, or complex project management. Demonstrated experience independently owning substantial projects or programs from planning through successful completion. Proven experience supervising teams, delegating responsibilities, monitoring performance, and maintaining accountability. Advanced practical proficiency in Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Jira, or comparable project-management platforms, with the ability to adopt Asana rapidly. Strong financial literacy, including budget oversight, cost reconciliation, payment tracking, and discrepancy identification. Exceptional organizational skills, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and operational judgment. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex priorities simultaneously under demanding deadlines. Experience coordinating distributed teams and international stakeholders across time zones. Excellent professional English and Spanish , both written and spoken. Outstanding ability to synthesize complex information into concise, structured, executive-level communications. High degree of autonomy, initiative, discretion, and personal accountability. Preferred Experience Experience in one or more of the following environments is particularly valuable: Luxury or experiential travel and destination management MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Exhibitions) International hospitality and high-standard guest services Complex event production or experiential program management International service operations involving multiple suppliers, stakeholders, and concurrent deliverables Experience with supplier contracting, reservations workflows, and client-sensitive operations is advantageous but not mandatory. What Success Looks Like The successful candidate will: Take full ownership of projects rather than waiting for instructions. Anticipate problems and resolve them before they become executive-level concerns. Ensure deliverables are accurate, complete, and verified before reporting them as finished. Maintain clear accountability across team members and external partners. Exercise independent judgment while escalating material decisions appropriately. Translate operational complexity into clarity, structure, and actionable recommendations. Establish systems that enable the organization to operate reliably and efficiently as it grows. Selection Process Our selection process is designed to assess demonstrated experience, operational judgment, and practical execution capabilities. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to participate in: Bilingual interviews in English and Spanish. A structured review of significant projects personally managed, including scope, budgets, team leadership, decision authority, and measurable outcomes. A practical operational assessment involving project planning, financial accuracy, competing priorities, supplier coordination, and executive reporting. Professional reference checks. We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate not only what they have managed, but how they personally established control, resolved challenges, and ensured successful outcomes. Working Arrangement & Compensation Location: Peru-based, fully remote Employment: Full-time Reporting to: CEO & CFO Compensation: USD 2,200–2,500 gross per month, depending on experience and qualifications. Exceptional candidates may be considered outside this range. Employment structure and applicable benefits will be confirmed during the hiring process. Performance reviews are anticipated at six and twelve months. Join Argos Destinations This is an opportunity to assume a meaningful leadership role within a growing international travel atelier, working directly with its founders to strengthen operational excellence and support the delivery of exceptional programs. We welcome applications from experienced professionals who combine strategic thinking with disciplined execution, independent judgment, and an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and accountability.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry! If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.
